title: 窗口边界唤醒与刷新退避提为共享 Rust 实现（先补双端 fixture）

target.module: core/collector（collector-policy 新增 refresh 模块）；apps/macos（RefreshBackoffPolicy / SubscriptionBoundaryWakePolicy）；apps/win src-tauri（runtime_core / scheduler）

goal: 把窗口边界唤醒（mac SubscriptionBoundaryWakePolicy / Windows runtime_core::boundary_wake）与刷新退避（mac RefreshBackoffPolicy / Windows scheduler::compute_backoff）收敛为 collector-policy 的一份纯 Rust 实现。先写 tests/fixtures/refresh-policy-parity/cases.json 并让两端现有实现跑通，确认口径一致后再迁移：Windows 进程内调用，mac 经 collector-policy-ffi 的 C ABI 进程内调用，删除两端各自的计算公式。Codex 四源合并经复核为 mac 专属（Windows 无对应实现），不在本卡范围。

precheck.description: 确认双端仍各自实现边界唤醒与退避、且尚无共享 fixture
precheck.command: ls tests/fixtures/refresh-policy-parity; grep -n 'static func delay' apps/macos/Sources/BruceAppCore/SubscriptionBoundaryWakePolicy.swift; grep -n 'func computeBackoff' apps/macos/Sources/BruceAppCore/RefreshBackoffPolicy.swift; grep -n 'pub fn boundary_wake' apps/win/src-tauri/src/runtime_core.rs; grep -n 'pub fn compute_backoff' apps/win/src-tauri/src/scheduler.rs; ls core/collector/crates/collector-policy/src
precheck.expected: fixture 目录不存在；mac 与 Windows 各有本地实现；collector-policy 下无 refresh 模块
precheck.evidence: 2026-10-27 开工前实测: tests/fixtures/refresh-policy-parity 不存在; mac SubscriptionBoundaryWakePolicy.swift:38 delay、RefreshBackoffPolicy.swift:25 computeBackoff; Windows runtime_core.rs:66 boundary_wake、scheduler.rs:78 compute_backoff; collector-policy/src 只有 lib.rs / quota.rs / request.rs, 无 refresh 模块, 未完成

after: scripts/adflow-verify  # 收口前门禁：Exit 4 禁止置 completed；目标状态预检使用 --card T17 --to completed --record，仅回写本卡 gate，Exit 0 后再同步状态，并以 --card T17 --receipt 复核、输出节点回执
